en: Towards a New Constitution of Iran — Fourth Edition

companions.en: English text (pages 1–53 of the same file)

note: Book «Advancing a Modern Constitution for a Democratic Iran» (ISBN 978-1-0689235-0-0), English pp. 1–53, Persian pp. 54–111. The document is the Persian preface and text, pp. 58–100; pp. 101–111 reprint the «اتحاد برای دمکراسی» resolution and the earlier prefaces. Article 1 leaves the form of state to a referendum; the text gives provisions for a monarchy (prime minister chosen by parliament) and a presidential republic. The book permits free distribution of the PDF. The Persian pages are drawn without a text layer, so they are vision OCR.
